# s4communication_inbound_user (List Resource)

Lists the inbound users of communication systems. Use with `terraform query`, optionally with `-generate-config-out` to write configuration with import blocks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the inbound users of one communication system
list "s4communication_inbound_user" "ext_api" {
  provider = s4communication

  config {
    communication_system_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `communication_system_uuid` (String) Only list the inbound users of the communication system with this UUID.
